partnershipPlan: Two owners from the client panel review the information sheet and the hunger-behaviour questions; nurse champions meet monthly with the trial coordinator.
socialListening: A three-month read of the group's social media pages and client comments for mentions of weight clinics and diet cost, recorded as composites.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: He used to jump into the car; now I have to lift him, and I did not realise his weight was part of it.
items.implication: Keep owner-reported mobility as the primary outcome.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The hardest part is the begging at dinner, and the kids slip him food.
items.implication: Record hunger behaviours and household feeding at each visit.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I love running the clinic, but two sessions a week is all I can do alongside theatre.
items.implication: Cap clinic numbers per practice at what two sessions can hold.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The special food costs twice what we normally buy, so we stopped after a month.
items.implication: Offer the diet discount to both groups and record cost concerns.

summary: Four composite voices on mobility, hunger, nurse time and diet cost.
